author: Linnaeus, 1758
status: 여름철새, 해마다 수십 마리 · 겨울에도 드물게 기록
summary: 해마다 수십 마리가 찾아오는 여름철새이며, 겨울에도 드물게 기록된다. 암컷이 구애하고 과시 행동을 하며, 봄부터 가을 사이에 한배에 알 4~6개를 낳아 수컷에게 품게 한 뒤 새 수컷과 다시 짝을 지어 알을 낳는다. 곤충, 조개, 지렁이와 볏과 식물, 여러 풀씨를 먹는 잡식성이다. 아프리카, 아시아, 오스트레일리아에 분포한다.

points.en: broad white central crown stripe from forehead to hindcrown

points.en: bold white crescent around the eye
greenish-brown back with bold black chequering and streaks

sexes.male: 암컷보다 작고 빛깔이 덜 선명하며, 목과 윗가슴에 회색 세로무늬가 있다.
sexes.female: 수컷보다 크고 빛깔이 선명하다. 갈색 머리에 넓은 흰 정수리선이 있고 목과 윗가슴은 밤색이다.

art.subject: Greater Painted-snipe (Rostratula benghalensis), adult female in the breeding season, as seen in Korean rice paddies from May to August: head, neck and upper breast deep chestnut-maroon, darker on the face; crown dark with a pale buff to whitish central stripe from the forehead to the hindcrown; a bold white patch around the eye extending back as a short white tear-shaped stripe; a blackish band at the lower edge of the breast; underparts white, the white continuing up as a narrow strap around the bend of the folded wing onto the mantle; back and wings bronzy olive-green finely barred and chequered black, with buff stripes along the mantle. Long reddish bill, greenish at the base, slightly drooping at the tip; dark eye; greenish legs.
art.pose: standing still at the muddy edge of a weedy paddy at dusk, side view
art.scene: Korean summer lowland: fallow and newly planted rice paddies with muddy edges, rank grass and rushes, evening light; no people, buildings or text
views: adult female, side view standing at a paddy edge: deep chestnut head and neck with a pale crown stripe and bold white eye patch, blackish breast band, white underparts with a white strap around the shoulder, bronzy-green back chequered black, long reddish bill with greenish base, greenish legs

adult male, side view standing: smaller and duller, grey-brown head, neck and upper breast with grey streaks, buff crown stripe and buff eye patch, wing coverts with large golden-buff spots, white underparts and shoulder strap, greenish legs
art.build: Snipe-like but chunkier wader, about 23.5cm long, larger than a starling; female larger and brighter than the male. Rounded head, short neck, plump body. Bill clearly longer than the head, fairly stout, straight and drooping slightly at the tip. Legs medium length, greenish, with long toes. Short rounded tail; broad rounded wings; flight slow and rail-like with legs dangling. Mostly active at dusk, standing still at muddy edges.
avoid: Do not paint a long, straight snipe bill with a striped snipe head — that is Common Snipe; this bird has a drooping-tipped reddish bill and a white eye patch.
Do not make the male brighter than the female; the female has the chestnut neck.
Do not paint a plain brown back; the back is olive-green with fine black chequering and buff stripes.
Do not omit the white strap curving up around the bend of the wing.
